findings.title: Old build callbacks can enter the replacement resource because owner is sampled at invocation
findings.rootCause: A retained old row closure dynamically resolves widget.onOpen, while action captures only the current resourceGeneration after entry.
findings.actualHost: DeviceGroupsPage fixed GlobalKey at27 and same-State includeArchived path change at558–575; open guard/capture at194–215 is current-session rather than original list epoch.
findings.impact: Stale UI intent can open an old row in the new resource context, retarget create/refresh/search, or reach unmounted setState.

existingHeldCallbackTest: 110–129 blocks a revoked isCurrent predicate; it does not cover replacement with current permission true
minimumDesign: Capture render generation/path/api/permitted and handler; check before all callback side effects; preserve in-flight guards and load semantics; add mounted method entry protection.
limitations: Manual source dataflow establishes a callable retained-closure path, not frequency or a rendered reproduction.
Existing session and HTTP guards remain effective; no authorization bypass claim.
One issue only; sampled host review is not an exhaustive ResourcePage consumer audit.
